article.story: Wyoming (2-3) at San Jose State (3-2), Oct. 9 at 9 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: San Jose State by 6.5. Against the spread: San Jose State 3-2, Wyoming 1-4. How to watch: CBS Sports Network Key stats San Jose State Offense Overall: 388.2 yards per game (75th in FBS) Passing: 255.6 yards per game (47th) Rushing: 132.6 yards per game (103rd) Scoring: 22.6 points per game (106th) San Jose State Defense Overall: 383.4 yards per game (100th in FBS) Passing: 258 yards per game (118th) Rushing: 125.4 yards per game (52nd) Scoring: 25 points per game (80th) Wyoming Offense Overall: 295.4 yards per game (131st in FBS) Passing: 143 yards per game (132nd) Rushing: 152.4 yards per game (81st) Scoring: 14.2 points per game (135th) Wyoming Defense Overall: 369.4 yards per game (84th in FBS) Passing: 178.6 yards per game (34th) Rushing: 190.8 yards per game (125th) Scoring: 22 points per game (58th) San Jose State ranks 120th in third down percentage, converting 32.4% of the time. Wyoming is 130th in the FBS with a -6 turnover margin, compared to San Jose State's 75th-ranked -1 margin. Wyoming is 120th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75% of trips. San Jose State's red zone defense ranks 47th at 80%. San Jose State is 112th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:57. Team leaders San Jose State Passing: Luke Weaver, 1,278 yards, 11 TDs, 5 INTs, 62.0 completion percentage Rushing: Jabari Bates, 487 yards on 104 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Carson Clark, 314 yards on 29 catches, 4 TDs Wyoming Passing: Tyler Hughes, 708 yards, 2 TDs, 6 INTs, 58.4 completion percentage Rushing: Samuel Harris, 257 yards on 52 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Jake Wilson, 158 yards on 12 catches, 0 TDs Last game San Jose State won 20-16 over Hawaii on Oct. 4. Weaver threw for 246 yards on 19-of-28 attempts (67.9%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. Bates had 74 rushing yards on 27 carries, adding two receptions for 39 yards. Clark recorded 74 yards on five catches with one touchdown. Wyoming lost 28-0 to North Dakota State on Oct. 3. Hughes passed for 52 yards on 5-of-14 attempts (35.7%) with no touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 12 times for 37 yards. Harris carried the ball 10 times for 31 yards. Charlie Coenen recorded 16 yards on one catch. Next game San Jose State plays at UTEP on Oct. 17. Wyoming hosts Northern Illinois on Oct. 17.
